The shelves are emptying because the owners have withheld £50m needed for new stock and paying wages. It’s just one of 600 stores in peril, and these employees just a few of 12,000 at risk of losing their jobs – with 30,000 jobs at risk in supply chains. Gordon Brothers, the US owner that bought Poundland for a symbolic £1 last year, specialises in buying and “restructuring” distressed companies.
